title: 9 משחקים וספרים שיעזרו להם להגיד מילים חדשות

stage.need: Language and vocabulary around ages 3 to 4. CDC 3 years: 'Says what action is happening in a picture or book when asked' and 'Asks who, what, where or why questions'; CDC 4 years: 'Says sentences with four or more words', 'Says some words from a song, story, or nursery rhyme'. CDC tips: read together and ask 'What is happening in the picture?' and 'what he thinks might happen next'. Games give a reason to name things and describe them, books give rhymes, pictures and questions.
stage.age_caveat: Ages are approximate: CDC milestones are what most children do by an age, not a deadline. Some 3 year olds say long sentences and some need more time; the frame says בסביבות and the caption says יש ילדים ש....
